shots.excerpt: Low side tracking shot at sand level, moving left to right with them. His front foot digs into the sand and he pitches forward, hands slamming down in a spray of sand.
highlight: Low side tracking shot at sand level
shots.voice: Shot 1. A low side tracking shot at sand level. His foot digs in and he faceplants mid-sprint.

shots.excerpt: Front tracking shot, camera backing up. MUST SHOW: a column of sand taller than a person bursts straight up beside him as she throws her hand out.
highlight: column of sand taller than a person
shots.voice: Shot 2. The camera backs up ahead of them, and a column of sand bursts up the moment she throws her hand out.

shots.excerpt: The camera whips right to follow as he crashes face-first into the sand in a cloud of dust, rolls, and ends on hands and knees, suit coated in sand.
shots.voice: The camera whips right to follow him. Suit coated in sand sells the comedy of the crash.

shots.excerpt: Wide, low angle. MUST SHOW: a huge transparent mass of sea water lifts out of the ocean and flies through the air, a glassy curling sheet hanging in the sky.
highlight: huge transparent mass of sea water
shots.voice: Shot 3. A wide low angle. A huge glassy sheet of sea water lifts out of the ocean and hangs in the sky.

shots.excerpt: He stares straight up at it; both stop. The whole water mass slams straight down on him in a crashing white wall, exploding into foam.
shots.voice: Shot 4. He stops and stares straight up. Then the whole wall of water slams straight down on him.

shots.excerpt: Locked-off low-angle medium shot at sand level: he sits soaked, defeated deadpan. A big lump of wet sand drops onto his head and stays there like a hat.
shots.voice: Shot 5. A locked-off shot and a deadpan face. The wet sand landing like a hat is the final punchline.
